tips.title: Close Reading
tips.description: Don't just read the summary. Read line-by-line to analyze form, tone, and the writer's hidden implications.

tips.title: Contextual Analysis
tips.description: Always study the historical and biographical background of the author before jumping into the main text.

tips.title: Thematic Linking
tips.description: Compare themes across different texts (e.g. Macbeth and Doctor Faustus) to enrich your final exam answers.

tips.title: Chapter Blocking
tips.description: Instead of trying to read an entire novel in one day, block out time for 2-3 chapters daily to maintain focus.

tips.title: Active Note-Taking
tips.description: Write down key quotes and your own critical opinions immediately after finishing a poem or chapter.

tips.title: Pomodoro Reading
tips.description: Read intense theoretical texts (like Modern Drama) for 25 minutes, then take a 5-minute break to digest the ideas.
